dedupe_keys.name: orbis company database moody s formerly bureau van dijk

description: Orbis is a global database of company information holding more than 635 million companies, over 99% of them private, compiled from more than 170 sources. It provides firmographics, standardised financial statements, corporate ownership structures and hierarchies with some 2 billion ownership links, 193 million of them active, mergers and acquisitions, financial strength indicators, cyber risk ratings and transfer pricing tools. It is operated by Moody's, which acquired the Bureau van Dijk product line; country products such as AIDA, FAME, DIANE and MARKUS serve European markets. Coverage is global. Access is by commercial subscription through the web interface, APIs, industry connectors, bulk feeds, cloud and real-time delivery and Office add-ins, typically held by universities and firms, with demonstrations arranged through Moody's sales team. Caveats: financial detail is thin for small private firms in many countries, and licence terms restrict redistribution of the data. For simulation it provides ownership and financial networks for studies of how the failure of a firm, bank or infrastructure operator spreads through corporate groups and supply chains, and for mapping who owns critical assets. It is related to the Panjiva and Open Supply Hub records in this catalogue, which add shipment and facility links between firms.
